skill.name: code-review
skill.description: Coordinates multi-agent pull request review, guideline checks, issue validation, and optional inline GitHub comments.
skill.summary: Runs structured PR reviews with multiple reviewer agents and validated findings.
skill.author: Bind

security_audit.summary: Most static backtick findings are false positives from Markdown code fences and inline formatting. Three findings are confirmed because the skill instructs agents to run Bun helper scripts, including one that can post GitHub comments after confirmation. A broader issue remains because the command grants unrestricted Bash access.

remediation.issue: Unrestricted Bash permission in command frontmatter
remediation.suggestion: Limit allowed-tools to the specific Bun and GitHub CLI commands required, or require explicit confirmation for other shell commands.
Document the helper script trust boundary and pin or verify the github-pr dependency before execution.

remediation.issue: Inline comments can write to GitHub
remediation.suggestion: Keep the confirmation step and show the destination PR, file, line, and comment body before posting.

content.user_title: Review Pull Requests with Multiple Agents
content.value_statement: Pull request reviews can miss bugs, project rules, and duplicate feedback. This skill coordinates reviewer agents, validates findings, and can post concise comments after confirmation.
actual_capabilities: Checks whether a pull request is eligible for review before continuing.
Discovers relevant AGENTS.md guideline files for changed paths.
Coordinates four reviewer agents for compliance, bugs, logic, and security concerns.
Validates candidate issues before presenting final review findings.
Can post inline GitHub comments when the user requests and confirms it.
limitations: Requires GitHub CLI authentication and the bundled github-pr skill.
Works on pull requests, not arbitrary local code folders.
May miss issues outside the diff or outside provided project guidelines.
Inline comments depend on accurate file paths, line numbers, and repository metadata.

use_cases.title: Screen PRs Before Human Review
use_cases.description: Run a structured review before assigning teammates, then inspect only validated findings.

use_cases.title: Check Project Rule Compliance
use_cases.description: Compare changed files with nearby AGENTS.md rules and surface only explicit violations.

use_cases.title: Prepare Review Comments
use_cases.description: Generate concise inline feedback for confirmed issues while keeping posting under user control.

prompt_templates.title: Review Current Pull Request
prompt_templates.prompt: Run /code-review and show only validated findings in the terminal.

prompt_templates.title: Review and Prepare Comments
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review where comments may be posted after approval.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run /code-review --comment, summarize confirmed issues, and ask before posting inline comments.

prompt_templates.title: Focus on Project Guidelines
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review for repositories with AGENTS.md rules.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the code review and prioritize clear AGENTS.md compliance issues with quoted rule text.

prompt_templates.title: Validate Risky Logic Changes
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review for security-sensitive or logic-heavy changes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this pull request for validated bugs, security issues, race conditions, and resource leaks.

output_examples.input: A pull request changes authentication flow and request validation.
output_examples.output: The review reports one high-confidence logic issue, explains the affected line, and asks before posting a comment.

output_examples.input: A documentation-only pull request has already received an AI review comment.
output_examples.output: The pre-check stops the workflow and avoids duplicate review output.

output_examples.input: A pull request violates a nearby AGENTS.md rule for test placement.
output_examples.output: The review cites the matching project rule and returns a concise inline comment proposal.

best_practices: Authenticate GitHub CLI before running the skill.
Review generated findings before posting comments to a pull request.
Keep AGENTS.md rules clear, specific, and close to the files they govern.
anti_patterns: Do not use the comment option when you only want local review output.
Do not treat every agent suggestion as confirmed without validation.
Do not use it as a replacement for tests, linters, or human approval.

faq.question: Does this skill post comments automatically?
faq.answer: No. It posts inline comments only when the comment option is used and the user confirms.

faq.question: What tools does it need?
faq.answer: It needs GitHub CLI authentication, Bun for helper scripts, and the bundled github-pr skill.

faq.question: What does it review?
faq.answer: It reviews pull request diffs for AGENTS.md compliance, obvious bugs, logic errors, and security issues.

faq.question: Can it review closed or draft PRs?
faq.answer: It runs a pre-check and stops when a PR is closed, draft, trivial, or already reviewed.

faq.question: How does it reduce false positives?
faq.answer: It uses multiple reviewer agents, validation agents, and an 80 percent confidence threshold before reporting issues.

faq.question: Can it post suggestions?
faq.answer: Yes. It can include complete suggestions for small fixes when a safe one-click change is possible.
